summary.en: The camera goes to another print on the desk: a parallax slide (default), a truck, or a pull back over the whole desk with a hop; then that print’s chip and caption.
summary.zh: 镜头移到桌上另一张截图：视差滑动（默认）、平移，或拉远看全桌再跳过去；然后读那张的标签和说明。

fits: Going from one piece of evidence to the next: the table to the product, the report to the chart.
notFor: A cut on a shared value (use value-match); the first scene.

intent.en: Keep the desk continuous: every print lies somewhere real, and the camera goes there.
intent.zh: 保持桌面连续：每张截图都在一个真实位置，镜头走过去。

content.en: The desk’s prints, the print to go to and the one it leaves; a caption (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 桌上的截图，目标和出发的那张；一句说明（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 从一件证据到下一件：从表格到产品，从报告到图表。

notFor.zh: 在共同数值上切换（用 value-match）；第一场。

pairs.note: then cut on a value the two share

en: Grid-hop needs at least three prints to read as a desk.
zh: 网格跳转至少要三张截图才像一张桌子。

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
